hypotheses.text: If Oscar Lindqvist had carried the ball forward instead, the turnover probability would have decreased and the chance of creating a higher-quality shot would have increased compared with the intercepted pass to A4.

If Oscar Lindqvist had passed to Kai Nakamura (CM) instead, the sequence would have been safer (lower turnover risk) and likely produced a higher expected goal probability than the intercepted pass to A4.
